Allows admins to create users with specific settings.
Different from RegisterRequest which is for self-registration.

source_name.title: Source Name
source_name.description: Name of the role if source is 'role'

root_entity_id.description: Root entity (organization) this user belongs to.

root_entity_name.description: Display name of the root entity (for convenience).

has_password.title: Has Password
has_password.description: Whether the account has a usable password (OAuth-only, magic-link-only and invited accounts do not). Lets UIs offer 'set a password' instead of 'change password'.

User response schema (safe to expose).

is_current.title: Is Current
is_current.description: True for the session that issued the calling access token (matched by the token's sid claim). Tokens minted before 0.1.0a35 carry no sid and match nothing.

UserSessionResponse.title: UserSessionResponse
UserSessionResponse.description: One active login session (refresh token), without secrets.

status.title: Status
status.description: New user status: active, suspended, or banned

suspended_until.title: Suspended Until
suspended_until.description: ISO 8601 datetime for suspension auto-expiry (only for 'suspended' status)

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason for status change (stored in audit log)

UserStatusUpdateRequest.title: UserStatusUpdateRequest
UserStatusUpdateRequest.description:
User status update request schema.

Used by admins to change user account status (activate, suspend, ban).

For suspensions, optionally provide suspended_until for auto-expiry.

is_superuser.title: Is Superuser
is_superuser.description: Whether the user should have platform-wide superuser privileges.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason for the audit log.

UserSuperuserUpdateRequest.title: UserSuperuserUpdateRequest
UserSuperuserUpdateRequest.description: Update a user's platform superuser flag.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: E.164 WhatsApp/SMS delivery number. Send null or empty to clear.
